First, I need to make sure that `train.py` can access the new STM functionality. Currently, `train.py` imports from `src.mythosmini.training.loop` the core training utilities (`TrainerDeps`, `TrainState`, `compute_loss`, `run_training`). It does not import anything from the new `stm` module, so any attempt to call `run_stm_from_checkpoint` would raise a `NameError`. I should add an import for both `StmConfig` (the configuration dataclass that controls STM behavior) and `run_stm_from_checkpoint` (the entry point that loads a checkpoint, runs the STM rounds, and writes new checkpoints). These live in `src.mythosmini.training.stm`, so the import line will be:

